tagline: Leading midstream energy company with integrated natural gas gathering, processing, liquids and pipeline operations
hero_kpi_rationale: Key financial performance indicator to assess operational profitability before financing, taxes and non-cash charges, enabling meaningful comparison with midstream sector peers

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Key financial performance indicator for evaluating operational profitability
kpis.description: Key indicator of the company's financial performance, defined as adjusted net income plus interest, depreciation, amortization, non-cash impairment charges, taxes, non-cash compensation and other non-cash items

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Annual cash dividend paid to shareholders, demonstrating earnings power and cash generation
kpis.description: The annual dividend of $4.12 per share paid to shareholders in 2025, up 4% from $3.96 in 2024, demonstrating the company's ability to generate stable and growing cash flows
kpis.signal: 4% dividend increase compared to 2024, reflecting improved cash flows

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Major infrastructure investment projects including pipelines, processing plants and export terminals
kpis.description: Capital expenditures of approximately $1.0 billion for the joint Texas City Logistics (400 MBbl/d LPG export terminal) and MBTC Pipeline (24-inch pipeline) projects, expected online in early 2028
kpis.signal: Major investments in Texas City Logistics and MBTC Pipeline projects scheduled for 2028

kpis.name: EnLink Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Transformational acquisition completed January 31, 2025, consolidating EnLink as wholly owned subsidiary
kpis.description: Major acquisition of EnLink completed on January 31, 2025 for $4.0 billion (41 million shares at closing fair value), consolidating natural gas and liquids processing operations into an integrated midstream platform
kpis.signal: Transformational acquisition to strengthen the company's integrated midstream position

kpis.name: Eiger Express Pipeline
kpis.explanation: New 450-mile natural gas pipeline from Permian Basin to Katy Texas with 25.5% ownership stake
kpis.description: Ownership interest in a new 450-mile, 48-inch natural gas pipeline designed to transport up to 3.7 Bcf/d from the Permian Basin to Katy, Texas, with a planned investment of $350 million for completion in mid-2028
kpis.signal: $350 million investment for a 25.5% stake in a major 450-mile pipeline

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Total amount paid in dividends per share over the fiscal year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Share of net income redistributed. >80% = potentially unsustainable.

risks.title: Commodity Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Fluctuations in natural gas, NGL and crude oil prices directly affect commodity sales revenues and processing margins. Despite a largely fee-based structure, the company remains exposed through its production sharing agreements and optimization and marketing activities.

risks.title: Project Investment Execution Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has committed significant investments in several major projects including Texas City Logistics ($700M), MBTC Pipeline ($280M), Eiger Express Pipeline ($350M) and Bighorn plant ($365M). Failure or delays in these projects could impact expected returns.

risks.title: High Leverage
risks.score_rationale: The company issued $3.0 billion in unsecured senior notes in August 2025 and maintains a significant debt level to fund acquisitions and CapEx projects. This increases interest costs and reduces financial flexibility.

risks.title: Regulatory and Tax Impact
risks.score_rationale: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) signed in July 2025 introduces changes to tax laws including full expensing of corporate tangible personal property and EBITDA-based calculations for business interest deductions. The impact on federal taxes and pipeline regulations may affect operations.

risks.title: Midstream Sector Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive midstream sector with multiple major players offering similar natural gas and liquids transportation, processing and storage services.

risks.title: Operational and Safety Risks
risks.score_rationale: Operations include construction and operation of pipelines, processing plants and terminals. Risks include accidents, equipment failures, environmental incidents and operational disruptions that could affect safety and profitability.

risks.title: Raw Material Supply Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on natural gas and NGL volumes from production basins to feed its midstream assets. Production declines due to market factors or geopolitical events could reduce volumes and revenues.

ai_positioning.summary: ONEOK does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 2025 10-K filing. The information provided focuses on midstream operations, major acquisitions (EnLink), infrastructure projects and commodity risk management strategies without reference to AI.
